correctness.rationale: Any nonzero four-variable cubic polar is a single GL4 orbit. Its cubic-plus-quadratic normal form yields, depending on the mixed cross-term, an empty commutation row or a strict 4-to-8 or 8-to-12 support inclusion, giving a universal obstruction without enumeration. Source-verified ternary, quadratic-block and direct-sum lemmas prove positive existence in exactly dimension three and every dimension at least five. The packaged Python checker exhausts the 960 four-variable nonlinear polynomials and tests small constructive cases; it does not substitute finite checks for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The theorem completes a sharp all-dimension existence spectrum for a natural cubic-Boolean generating-function condition, filling the precise gap between the well-established ternary seed and the higher-dimensional counterexample constructions. Explicit support nesting explains the impossibility structurally and distinguishes it from positive quadratic separation in the same dimension; it is not merely a finite list or routine parameter substitution.
